session_selection.rationale: Workspace-local root 01a0340e plus 13 descendants is the benchmark sequence.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable f679644 build succeeded with documented CMake external roots inside network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 pids. No CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: f679644 main.cpp:142–155 accepts --restart but never uses restart_file; solver.run initializes freestream. restart_final.vtk is identical to field_final.vtk, with no source reader; its field contents exist, so it is not claimed to be an empty placeholder.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, flux, viscous, reconstruction, implicit and output, but main.cpp contains unfinished development commentary and fixed 2D state.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No external solver executable or copied core directly established in reviewed source; no exhaustive external similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:35–44 selects mesh from case JSON rather than only two filenames; output.cpp:247–249 fixes timestamps and success flag, and solver.cpp:356 hardcodes zero moment.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:179–229 keeps a full GlobalMesh on every rank during solver.run; this violates TASK prohibited shortcut 7. METIS partition and neighbor communication are present. Production-source binding is unresolved.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:415–422 caps steady CFL at5, :459–464 applies density and pressure fallback; status is unconditionally successful at :712–715 despite selected failed results.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Previous structural validator results are recorded; independent clean build passed. Selected Re200 iteration metadata conflicts with its unchanged residual history and no unsteady run was repeated.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: main.cpp:213–225 retains development comments; metadata uses fixed 2024 timestamps and output moment is always zero. Historical result packages require separate provenance.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: types.h:9–18 defines four conserved variables and ideal-gas parameters; flux.cpp computes 2D conservative Euler flux. This does not validate numerical outcomes.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:62–72 reads only the first base/zone and :126–130 accepts separate TRI/QUAD sections, not MIXED sections. geometry.cpp computes 2D polygon area; rank-distributed solver keeps a full mesh on every rank.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:89–101,162–170,210–227 assembles local inviscid face contributions; viscous direct-difference implementation :229–275 is limited, and inviscid limiter is globally zero.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:24–67 implements Rusanov numerical flux; no Roe/Harten assertion required for this report. Low-Mach numerical drag is large.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: boundary.cpp:14–91 implements farfield, slip and no-slip ghost states; output.cpp obtains wall values. Unknown BC strings default to FARFIELD in mesh.cpp:11–21, weakening error handling.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: f679644 solver.cpp:89–96 initializes every limiter to zero; face paths use these factors. report.tex:147–170 claims active second-order/Barth with fallback only, contradicted by submitted source. 12f77fb has same source SHA; earlier cbe40ee also zeroed multipliers. Exact historic binary remains unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: f679644 solver.cpp:89–96 initializes every limiter to zero; face paths use these factors. report.tex:147–170 claims active second-order/Barth with fallback only, contradicted by submitted source. 12f77fb has same source SHA; earlier cbe40ee also zeroed multipliers. Exact historic binary remains unbound.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:173–205 wall viscous treatment and :229–275 direct cell-difference thin-layer gradients; :324–332 explicitly projects wall shear tangentially. High drag remains a result credibility defect, not proof of normal-traction mislabel. output.cpp:77 hardcodes cf=0, and all selected laminar wall rows confirm it despite nonzero viscous drag.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:414–452 invokes LU-SGS with steady CFL capped at5 and fixed minimum inner iterations, not a measured steady inner convergence test.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:528–607 implements BDF/inner iteration, but :599–615 updates time histories before logging a new BDF residual; that logged term is not the residual solved in the inner loop. Submitted residual rows all say five iterations; revised metadata max124 contradicts them.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: main.cpp:179–229 keeps a full GlobalMesh on every rank during solver.run; this violates TASK prohibited shortcut 7. METIS partition and neighbor communication are present. Production-source binding is unresolved.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Validator reports all eight selected packages structurally complete, but main.cpp ignores restart input and solver.cpp:356 always emits zero moment. Structural conformance does not establish usable restart or truthful metadata. output.cpp:77 hardcodes cf=0, and all selected laminar wall rows confirm it despite nonzero viscous drag.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Existing explicit validator passes all eight; it does not detect flat Re200 periodicity, false max-inner statistics, disabled reconstruction, or full mesh held on all ranks.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 metadata periodic contradicts flat t>=200 forces; M2 laminar claims converged while Cd drops20.8% in final65 rows; M015 inviscid final 10% Cd changes15.2%.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd7.226 and Re200 Cd4.853 with no shedding are not credible; low-Mach M015 laminar Cd0.583 is unusually large. Source/run relation remains qualified.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted report PDF has 15 readable pages covering five NACA cases; checkpoint 0b4616f provides extra standalone histories and field images. Re200 late plots show no periodicity and historic source figures are omitted under curation.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Main report covers five cases and marks others incomplete; historic checkpoint has extra standalone plots and final-case summary. Re200 metadata success/inner statistics conflict with unchanged force and residual histories.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Checkpoint metadata changed max iteration count and convergence statistics while residual history remained byte-identical and always reports five iterations; fixed 2024 timestamps, null revision and historical report/result differences weaken provenance.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: main.cpp:142–155 parses --restart into restart_file but never uses it before solver.run(): the option silently starts freestream. Selected restart_final.vtk equals field_final.vtk byte-for-byte; the field is real but final source provides no restart reader. Build not independently checked yet. Clean immutable build passed in documented container configuration. solver.cpp:356 always sets moment to zero. output.cpp:77 emits cf=0 for every wall point despite nonzero viscous drag.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:62–72 reads only first CGNS base and zone; :126–130 supports separate triangle/quad sections, not MIXED. Geometry/adjacency exist, but multi-zone and mixed-section criteria are unmet.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:89–101,162–170,210–227 assembles face residual; flux.cpp implements Rusanov and boundary.cpp handles farfield/slip/no-slip. Unknown BC string defaults to farfield; zero inviscid limiters are assessed separately.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: solver.cpp:89–96,113–130,145–153,210–215 sets all reconstruction multipliers zero; report.tex:147–170,499–501 incorrectly claims active second order/Barth limiter. Least-squares gradient and limiter code exist but production inviscid residual does not use them for higher order. Positivity checks exist; exact binary attribution remains qualified.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:173–205,229–275 uses a wall normal/direct difference thin-layer viscous approximation; :324–332 projects shear onto wall tangent. Re20/Re200 and low-Mach laminar forces are physically suspect, without proving the precise cause. output.cpp:67–77 writes cf=0 on all wall rows rather than the nonzero tangential wall shear used in forces; selected laminar surface files confirm zero cf.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF-like source exists, but checkpoint metadata changed observed max inner iterations 5→124 and fraction 0→0.96 while residual history remains unchanged with inner_iter=5 for every row; exact actual target misses remain unproved. Source solver.cpp fixes last ratio 0; CFL cap5. Deduct inner-log/target credibility. solver.cpp:599–615 updates BDF history before recomputing logged residual, so the logged temporal term is not the just-solved BDF residual; initial/source binding remains qualified.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: f679644 main.cpp:179–229 reads and retains the entire GlobalMesh on every rank while solver.run executes, violating TASK prohibited shortcut 7. METIS and local/ghost halos exist; no numbered DQ9 is asserted solely from a full mesh.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Manifest and selected results provide case quantities; Re20 Cd7.226, Re200 Cd4.853 with flat late lift, M2 laminar Cd3.146 and strongly falling tail, M015 laminar Cd0.583. Deliverable availability and source binding are individually qualified.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Main f679644 report covers five cases and says others incomplete; historical contestant checkpoint 0b4616f provides other standalone plots and a manifest. Actual Re200 has no periodicity despite success metadata; checkpoint convergence statistics contradict unchanged histories. Rendered report remains readable.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate flux/viscous/mesh modules provide some organization; types.h:9–10 hardcodes four-component state and 2D vector, boundary branches and perfect-gas formulas constrain 3D/EOS/species extension.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 4→2: report.tex:320–324 gives Cd0.0617/Cl9.2e−5 and delivered PDF pp5–7 contains residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Last 308 force rows Cd0.072724→0.061706 (15.2% decrease, range0.059928–0.072724), inconsistent with a settled steady force despite reported 4 residual orders; low-Mach drag is also large. Exact production source remains unbound; no CFD rerun.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Original 2→3: contestant checkpoint 0b4616f solver/report/run_manifest.csv reports final Cd0.0501852 and Cl−0.0015396; f679644 report.tex:402–404 gives Cd0.050 and PDF pp9–11 delivers residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Last162 Cd0.048839→0.050185 and Cl−0.001659→−0.001540. Four residual orders and a transonic shock field support limited credit, while remaining drift and source binding limit confidence. The manifest is contestant-delivered historical evidence, not a curated-tip blob. No CFD rerun.

Current last227 Cd7.23824→7.22596 (stable but much higher than credible Re20 cylinder drag); PDF report.tex:511–514 says cylinder cases incomplete. Historical run/source binding remains uncertain. cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 2→1: checkpoint 0b4616f run_manifest.csv gives final Cd4.8532587021 and Cl−0.0023802775736, and its delivered residual/force and velocity-wake figures exist despite omission from curated report. The force figure and all 10001 current t>=200 rows show constant Cd/Cl, not shedding; no St or late periodic force summary was found. Metadata claims periodic. flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Selected solver/results/cylinder_m010_laminar_re200/metadata.json says completed=true, statistically_periodic, t=300 but the entire submitted t=200–300 force window has exactly constant Cd=4.8532587021 and Cl=−0.0023802775736; no late shedding is shown. M2 laminar metadata says converged, but last 65 Cd rows decrease 3.9742929239→3.1464435562 (20.8%); report.tex:511–514 and run_manifest.csv mark this case incomplete/not converged. Generation relation between report and workspace results is not established. No CFD rerun. The unchanged residual history SHA 5c4a2e29fb4d61787bc436ed3bb994de7a2683dde84bb3ffcc693585c23faa95 has inner_iter=5 in all 30000 rows. Between 12f77fb and 0b4616f, metadata changed observed max 5→124, misses 30000→1200, fraction 0→0.96 and final ratio 0.46→0.00099 without changing that history. This proves metadata/history incompatibility, not the exact actual miss count.

flags.flag: Full mesh or full state replicated on all MPI ranks during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable f679644:solver/src/main.cpp:179–181 reads GlobalMesh on every rank; :192–199 partitions and constructs local mesh without releasing it; :211–229 invokes solver.run() in the same scope while global_mesh remains alive. TASK.md prohibited shortcut 7 prohibits full-mesh replication during iterations. METIS and neighbor halos are real, so this is not numbered DQ9’s narrower full-state/geometric-split condition. Selected metadata revision is null, so exact source/result binding remains uncertain.

flags.flag: Report claims second-order reconstruction or a shock limiter disabled in production cases
flags.evidence: Immutable f679644 solver/src/solver.cpp:89–96 sets every inviscid limiter to zero, then :113–130 and :145–153,210–215 use these factors in face reconstruction; report.tex:147–170,499–501 claims active Barth–Jespersen and second-order accuracy with first-order only a positivity fallback. 12f77fb and 0b4616f carry the same solver.cpp SHA 7664b362da6c56ecac8cf8701bc1a3180ddfd92980c1f2b33a04480cb28df3b0; earlier cbe40ee explicitly zeros the computed limiters as well. Binary/source binding is not independently proven.
No invocation of an external CFD solver executable found in the reviewed build/solver source.
No direct evidence force/residual files were produced without solving; contradictory edited iteration metadata and hardcoded cf are separate findings.
main.cpp:35–44 reads the mesh path from case input. The first-zone-only reader is a geometry limitation, not proof of two filename branches.
Selected np1/np8 Re20 Cd7.225956/7.226503, Cl−0.003572/−0.003430; M080 NACA Cd0.050185/0.050132, Cl−0.001540/−0.001462. No order-one absolute force mismatch established.
solver.cpp includes implicit steady LU-SGS and BDF-like transient paths, not an explicit-only implementation.
Rusanov, BDF, viscous and reconstruction components exist in source; claimed active second-order/Barth operation is specifically charged under DQ10, not duplicated here.

Reviewed plots are case-labeled; no proof of unrelated source field/CSV was identified. Historical selected results match 0b4616f blobs for four reviewed cases. Not every figure generation was independently reconstructed.
METIS_PartGraphKway and local state/halo communication are present; replicated full mesh during iteration separately violates TASK shortcut 7, not this narrower full-state/geometric-split trigger.

output.cpp:67–74 obtains boundary state, and no-slip boundary.cpp:117–120 sets wall velocity zero; cf=0 is separately defective, not evidence of adjacent-cell velocities being mislabeled as wall rows.
plot_results.py:263–267 requests Mach and Pressure for their respective image names; no directly demonstrated wrong-variable mapping in reviewed figures.
No copied or wrapped external CFD core identified in reviewed source; no exhaustive external authorship/similarity search was performed.

limitations: No rerun; Re200 was not rerun.
Raw packages/PDF excluded from curated tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars not validated by cfdeval check.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

All applicable ten sections, eight cases, 27 review points and 13 numbered DQ rules reviewed to available evidence. Historical producing executable and some standalone-figure provenance remain unbound; no CFD/Re200 rerun.
